bearing_additional_availability.conclusion: A second US source for the exact Aurora part is established. The combined stock/factory-order wording does not verify sufficient quantity or a shipment date. Do not combine another manufacturer’s GE20 dimensions or rating with Aurora’s record.

interface_handoff: Use a purchased, matched MGM yoke/pin/retainer assembly; the chamber rod thread is 5/8-18 UNF.
The 14.2875 mm fork opening limits the central linkage-eye thickness and running-clearance stack. It does not specify an allowable load.
The chamber clevis is 15.875 mm nominal bore, distinct from the 20 mm spherical hanger pivots.
Rod setup must preserve the MGM 3-degree maximum misalignment through full stroke and verify actual thread engagement; no thread cut length is released here.
No undimensioned ear profile, pin cross-hole or cotter clearance should be presented as an exact OEM manufacturing model.
